serverMetadata.instructions:
The GitHub MCP Server provides tools to interact with GitHub platform.

Tool selection guidance:
	1. Use 'list_*' tools for broad, simple retrieval and pagination of all items of a type (e.g., all issues, all PRs, all branches) with basic filtering.
	2. Use 'search_*' tools for targeted queries with specific criteria, keywords, or complex filters (e.g., issues with certain text, PRs by author, code containing functions).

Context management:
	1. Use pagination whenever possible with batches of 5-10 items.
	2. Use minimal_output parameter set to true if the full information is not needed to accomplish a task.

Tool usage guidance:
	1. For 'search_*' tools: Use separate 'sort' and 'order' parameters if available for sorting results - do not include 'sort:' syntax in query strings. Query strings should contain only search criteria (e.g., 'org:google language:python'), not sorting instructions.

{"command":"set -euo pipefail
REPO='edburns/dd-3068633-darwin-arm64-05'; REMOTE='origin'; PR=4; ISSUE=2
remote_url=$(git remote get-url "$REMOTE")
normalized=$(printf '%s' "$remote_url" | sed -E 's#^(git@github.com:|https://github.com/|ssh://git@github.com/)##; s#\.git$##')
[ "$normalized" = "$REPO" ] || { echo "REMOTE_MISMATCH url=$remote_url normalized=$normalized"; exit 1; }
help=$(gh pr edit --help 2>&1)
printf '%s' "$help" | grep -q '@copilot' || { echo 'COPILOT_TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED'; gh --version; exit 1; }
echo "REMOTE_OK=$remote_url"
echo 'PR:'
gh pr view "$PR" -R "$REPO" --json number,title,state,isDraft,headRefName,headRefOid,baseRefName,mergeable,reviewRequests,url
echo 'ISSUE:'
gh issue view "$ISSUE" -R "$REPO" --json number,title,state,url
echo 'TIMELINE_LINKS:'
gh api "/repos/$REPO/issues/$ISSUE/timeline?per_page=100" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' --jq '[.[] | select(.event=="cross-referenced") | .source.issue | select(.pull_request != null) | {number,state,title}]'
echo 'COPILOT_REVIEWS:'
gh api "/repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR/reviews" --jq '[.[] | select((.user.login // "") | test("^copilot-pull-request-reviewer(\\[bot\\])?$"; "i")) | {id,commit_id,state,submitted_at}]'","description":"Validate remote and PR preflight","initial_wait":120,"mode":"sync"}
